summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of LOW UI/UX editor. All 13 requested features verified working: dashboard, project card navigation, New Project creation, sidebar tabs (pages/layers/components/templates/import), layer selection updating properties panel + selection outline, live property edits (X, Y, opacity, text), canvas drag, top toolbar tool creation (rectangle/text/image/component), design/prototype mode switch, preview modal open/close, zoom in/out, autosave status transitions, and localStorage persistence after reload. Only minor testability concerns found.
action_items: MINOR (testability): CanvasArea wrapper div carrying data-testid='canvas-node-<id>' is styled with position:absolute; left:0; top:0 and no width/height, while the inner NodeView is also position:absolute. This makes the wrapper's bounding_box 0x0, so automated tools targeting canvas-node-<id> can't compute the visible node position for drag. Manual user drag works (mousedown bubbles up). Consider moving data-testid onto the NodeView element itself, or wrapping content so the testid element reflects the node's real bounding box.

MINOR (testability): RightPropertiesPanel renders the empty-state aside WITHOUT data-testid='properties-panel' when no node is selected (only added in the selected branch). Add data-testid='properties-panel' to the empty-state aside as well so the panel is always addressable by tests.
critical_code_review_comments: EditorShell.jsx uses a module-level `let counter` and window.__lowMounts - fine for MVP but not ideal; consider useRef.
CanvasArea drag handlers attach/remove window listeners correctly; no leak seen.
storage.js seed() writes to localStorage on first getProjects() call; idempotent and OK.
Selection outline outlineOffset:0 combined with pointer-events-none is correct; handles use pointer-events-auto - good.
No error/console warnings observed during full interaction flow.
seed_data_creation: None - app auto-seeds 3 dummy projects (Finance App, Shop Onboarding, Health Tracker) on first load via localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 features from the review request are functionally working end-to-end. Only two minor testability/data-testid issues remain (see action_items). Drag was verified by targeting the visible child of canvas-node-<id> (>div) since the wrapper itself has 0x0 hitbox. Persistence confirmed: title text 'PersistedTitle' survived a full page reload. Autosave transitions 'Saving…' -> 'Saved' work with ~600ms debounce. No backend involvement.
